The record array is then sorted by sub_5890AA (0x005890AA, 16-byte stride, comparator sub_44A130 at 0x0044A130). Coverage is evaluated via VisibilityFrustumTest (0x0044A170) on the sorted records, split by the count midpoint v16 = (v7+1)/2, and the better-scoring half's result is selected into this (copied via qmemcpy of 0x1C bytes or recomputed with flag 1 depending on a6).

For each node, loop i from 0 to 2 (three vertex pairs): compute v12 = a5 * *(*(v6 + 8*i) + 12) + a4 * **(v6 + 8*i), a weighted blend of two coordinates per vertex.
On an unordered compare flag (v14 | v15, i.e. NaN/orderedness), assign v20 = v12, capturing the value as the per-node minimum.
Track the running maximum v10 = max(v10, v12) via the v21 temporary.

Write the per-node 16-byte record at the running output pointer v9 (starting at a3+8): node pointer v6 at offset 0, min v20 at offset 4, max v10 at offset 8, and midpoint (v10 + v20) * 0.5 at offset 12 after advancing v9 by 4 floats.
Advance to the next node via the next pointer at node+28; repeat while the node pointer is non-null, incrementing the count v7.
Sort the record array with sub_5890AA(a3, v7, 16, sub_44A130) using a 16-byte stride and the comparator sub_44A130 (0x0044A130).
Compute the split index v16 = (v7 + 1) / 2 and branch on whether v7 / 2 == v16, i.e. whether the node count is even.
Even count: single VisibilityFrustumTest(this, a3, v7/2, v7, a6) (0x0044A170) over the whole record range.
Odd count: evaluate both halves with VisibilityFrustumTest(v18, a3, v7/2, v7, 0) and VisibilityFrustumTest(v19, a3, v16, v7, 0) (0x0044A170).
Compare the two half results: if v18[6] >= v19[6] select the v19 half, else select the v18 half.
Selected half: when a6 is set, recompute into this via VisibilityFrustumTest(this, a3, index, v7, 1) (0x0044A170); otherwise copy the selected 0x1C-byte result into this with qmemcpy.
